topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning objectives, and sets up the key themes of cancer evolution, microenvironments, and cell of origin.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how both genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and provide competitive growth advantages during tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and examine how tissue hierarchy and the differentiation state of the cell of origin influence malignant transformation in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Inflammatory and Microenvironmental Promotion of Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external inflammatory stimuli and microenvironmental signals act as promotional triggers that induce stem-like states and drive malignant outgrowth in initiated tissues.

topics.label: Established Tumor Stroma, Spatial Technologies, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the dependence of established cancers on supportive stromal microenvironments, the experimental tools used to spatially profile these cellular interactions, and an overarching summary of tumor coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
